title: Petrobras Approves Participation in Diesel Subsidy
seoTitle: Petrobras Approves Participation in Diesel Subsidy
subtitle: Board of Directors authorizes financial support across the entire fuel supply chain
excerpt: Petrobras officializes financial support for diesel producers and importers, reinforcing the government-backed subsidy program.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Petrobras's Board of Directors approved this Friday (18) participation in the economic subsidy aimed at diesel producers and importers, as well as companies operating throughout its supply chain.

The measure follows the subsidy established by the government, which aims to reduce fuel production and importation costs, contributing to price stability in the domestic market.

With this approval, Petrobras joins the support program, aligning its operations with the guidelines established for the diesel subsidy, which could impact the country's supply and demand dynamics for the product.

With information from Agência Brasil.
